content.short: TokensFarm is a farms-as-a-Service provider offering off-the-shelf farms that can go live within minutes.
content.description: TokensFarm enables projects to rapidly deploy staking farms and LP farms across a broad set of networks, strengthening token performance and boosting liquidity across markets. It also provides vesting contracts to promote transparency in token releases, offering disciplined release schedules. For users, TokensFarm functions as a one-stop shop for yield farming opportunities, giving convenient access to a variety of farms and liquidity pools from a single place.
content.meta: TokensFarm offers farms-as-a-Service with off-the-shelf farms ready in minutes. Discover TokensFarm and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
